name: POPEYES LOUISIANA KITCHEN OPERATED BY TICE

violations.text:
Buildup of food debris/soil residue on equipment door handles.
Buildup on walk in freezer door handle

Equipment and utensils not properly air-dried - wet nesting.
Clean containers stacked on drying rack
1 Live, small flying insects found in kitchen in prep area. Advised manager to kill
Wet mop not stored in a manner to allow the mop to dry.

Working containers of food removed from original container not identified by common name.
Spice shaker next to chicken batter station

Food-contact surfaces in contact with time/temperature control for safety food not cleaned at least every four hours.
Bulk bin flour scoop-
Observed scoop to have raw chicken residue in bulk flour bin

Stop Sale issued on time/temperature control for safety food due to temperature abuse.
Bulk flour bin with raw chicken pieces

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Raw chicken pieces in flour bin observed at 75f. Unable to determine time. Manager states they do not sift flour every four hours.
